paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance for different configurations of token-precision trade-offs in KV cache compression on Llama-3-8B-Instruct. The x-axis represents layers, categorized into five groups: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, with no units provided and the scale type appears to be categorical. The y-axis displays the relative change in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, and units of percentage points. There are four lines in the plot: the yellow line represents LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit, with a solid line and no markers; the red line represents LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit with a solid line and square markers; the light blue line represents RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit with a solid line and no markers; and the dark blue line represents RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit, with a solid line and square markers. Starting at Layer1-4 and ending at Layer29-32, the yellow line begins around 0% and ends near 0%, remaining relatively stable; the red line starts slightly below 0% and ends slightly above 0%; the light blue line begins around -2.5% and ends slightly above 0%, showing a general upward trend; the dark blue line starts around -2.5% and ends around 0%, initially decreasing to around -15% at Layer13-20 then increasing. A gray dashed line representing the Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit runs along the 0% relative change line.
